summary: The Prism Chambers of Crystal Root are the metaphysical nexus where Brell’s crystal veins converge. Divine resonance pulses through the chambers, creating living constructs and planar bleed‑through.
history: Formed when Brell infused the crystal lattice with divine resonance.
Crystal veins extended into other planes, creating planar bleed‑through.
Resonance spirits emerged from the first pulses.
Collapse pressure fractured the chambers into prisms.
The Crystal Sovereign manifested as embodiment of resonance.
